# Oprør i Europa - ændrer det pengestrømmene?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-10-19  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Danish episode of Euroinvestor's Millionærklubben (in Danish) about the political unrest in southern Europe, mainly France: its state debt, French yields above Italy's and Greece's, and the risk from left- and right-wing populists ahead of the spring 2027 election. The panel also covered falling US yields, growing doubt about whether AI capex will pay off (Gartner warns about heavily indebted neoclouds such as CoreWeave), and rotation into defensive, 'boring' stocks such as Danish pharma, staples and Lundbeck. The panel was cautious on US and French consumer stocks and on French banks. Within France, energy, Airbus and Schneider Electric were seen as the more attractive names.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 HLUN-B — Lundbeck | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Lars bought Lundbeck and told his clients to buy; Fruergaard as chairman plus a technical breakout setup.

#### Reasoning

Host guest Lars Persson (technical analyst) has bought the stock. It has repeatedly tested the 47-50 resistance. He hopes for a breakout as money rotates out of tech/AI into overlooked Danish pharma. Lundbeck often surprises positively in its reports. The planned chairman Lars Fruergaard is well regarded. Risks are the weak pipeline and limited liquidity because of the foundation's stake.

#### Sell Triggers

- if it fails to break through 47-50 resistance
- if pipeline remains weak and reports disappoint
- if rotation back into tech reverses defensive flows

> *"Så jeg har faktisk selv sagt til mine kunder, at jeg synes, vi skal købe nogle Lundbæk"*

---

### ⛔ CRWV — CoreWeave | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Gartner flags heavily indebted neoclouds; CoreWeave named as a soft spot, down about 25% last week.

#### Reasoning

Frank Hvid cites the Gartner report: AI capex returns don't add up, and 85% of neoclouds may not survive 4-5 years. He names CoreWeave, Oracle, OpenAI and Anthropic as the soft spots to watch.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI capex returns prove sustainable
- if CoreWeave deleverages

> *"Så jeg vil sige, at Oracle, Anthropic, OpenAI og CoreWeave, det er nogle af de selskaber, som er de bløde punkter"*

---

### 🟠 ORCL — Oracle | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Named as an AI-boom soft spot to watch.

#### Reasoning

Frank Hvid groups Oracle with the indebted AI infrastructure players most exposed if AI investment returns disappoint.

#### Sell Triggers

- if AI investment returns disappoint

> *"det er dem, man skal holde øje med"*

---

### 🟢 AIR — Airbus | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars picks Airbus as the French stock to own: a European success story that beat Boeing.

#### Reasoning

In a France that is otherwise unattractive, Lars Persson favors Airbus for its global dominance in commercial aircraft. He sees the risk as future competition from Chinese and Brazilian makers.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Chinese aircraft makers gain share
- if French political turmoil hits industrials

> *"Så Airbus, ja, og sådan nogle af de der franske våbenaktier, vil jeg måske lure lidt på også"*

---

### 🟠 TTE — TotalEnergies | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars and Michelle would pick French energy because it doesn't rely on its home market.

#### Reasoning

Both panelists prefer French energy over consumer names because TotalEnergies' revenue is global and so less exposed to French domestic turmoil.

#### Sell Triggers

- if oil prices fall sharply
- if France introduces windfall corporate taxes

> *"så total energi kunne være i hvert fald lige PT"*

---

### 🟠 SU — Schneider Electric | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Michelle would look at Schneider Electric on the French market.

#### Reasoning

Michelle Nørgaard would turn to energy and electrification names such as Schneider rather than French consumer stocks.

#### Sell Triggers

- if French political risk escalates to corporate tax hikes

> *"Ja, sjovt nok kigge på Schneider Electric"*

---

### ⛔ MC — LVMH | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Both panelists would avoid French consumer stocks such as LVMH.

#### Reasoning

French consumer stocks have had little tailwind, and the political unrest makes the outlook worse.

#### Sell Triggers

- if consumer demand recovers
- if French political risk eases

> *"Jeg vil i hvert fald holde mig for dem, som du selv har sagt, L'Oreal og LVM"*

---

### ⛔ OR — L'Oréal | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Michelle explicitly avoids L'Oréal.

#### Reasoning

Same reasoning as LVMH: French consumer stocks lack tailwind amid the unrest.

#### Sell Triggers

- if consumer demand recovers

> *"Jeg vil i hvert fald holde mig for dem, som du selv har sagt, L'Oreal og LVM"*

---

### 🟢 ALK-B — ALK-Abelló | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Michelle bought ALK as a defensive pick in the stock game.

#### Reasoning

This is a short-term stock-game position as part of a move into defensive stocks, so conviction is low.

#### Sell Triggers

- if defensive rotation reverses

> *"og så har jeg købt ALK"*
